name: Sacred Gin
distillery: Sacred Spirits Company (home distillery in Highgate)
owner: Sacred Spirits Company (founders Ian Hart and Hilary Whitney)
production: Vacuum distillation in glassware at low temperature
Each botanical distilled separately, then blended
Small runs of a few hundred bottles
history: 2009 | First batch made on 22 May 2009 in Ian Hart's house in Highgate
2013 | Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition
palate: Liquorice, gentle sweetness, pepper, hint of violet
notes: 12 botanicals; Wikipedia names the ones listed, The Gin is In additionally lists coriander, grapefruit, licorice, orris [cần kiểm tra]. Tasting notes from reviewer (The Gin is In), not producer. Name refers to frankincense (Boswellia sacra).
